gp.heading: Gross Profit
gp.text: Gross profit increased $285,768 or 8% to $4,071,417 in 2024 compared to $3,785,648 in 2023. Gross margin remained at 23% for the years ended 2024 and 2023. The increase in gross profit was due to growth of the shipping coordination and label generation service revenues.

opex.heading: Operating Expenses
opex.text: Total operating expenses in 2024 were $4,564,799 compared to $4,373,471 in 2023, an increase of $191,328 or 4%. The increase is mainly due to the salaries for newly hired employees and consultants in 2024.

costs.heading: Operating Expenses
costs.text: Total operating expenses in 2024 were $4,564,799 compared to $4,373,471 in 2023, an increase of $191,328 or 4%. The increase is mainly due to the salaries for newly hired employees and consultants in 2024.

nonop.heading: Other Income/Expense, net
nonop.text: Net other income in 2024 was $1,215,925 compared to $849,258 in 2023, an increase of $366,667 or 43%. The 2024 amount is made up of a gain of $1,192,182 on the Embolx, Inc. note receivable and an additional gain of $25,884 for the note receivable with 5String Solutions.

tax.heading: (Benefit) Provision for Income Taxes
tax.text: Total income tax (benefit) provision for 2024 was $(41,049) compared to $(91,779) in 2023. The change of $50,730 is a result of the net effect of the adjustment for long term tax liabilities.

net.heading: Net Income
net.text: The Company reported a net income in 2024 of $763,592 compared to $353,214 for the same period in 2023. The basic income per common share in 2024 is $0.09 compared to $0.04 per common share in 2023.

wc.heading: Working Capital and Liquidity
wc.text:
The Company had cash and cash equivalents of $1,284,965 on December 31, 2024 compared to $1,731,993 on December 31, 2023. The Company had working capital of (629,467) on December 31, 2024 compared to $2,592,522 on December 31, 2023, a decrease of (3,221,989). The decrease in working capital is primarily attributed to the reclassification of the short term note receivable to long term.

Management believes that the Company has adequate cash resources to fund operations during the next 12 months. In addition, management continues to explore opportunities and partnerships to grow the Paid platform of services. However, there can be no assurance that the anticipated growth in new business will occur, and that the Company will be successful in launching new products and services. Management continues to seek alternative sources of capital to support the growth of future operations.

net sales.heading: Revenues
net sales.text:
The following table compares total revenue for the periods indicated.

Revenues increased $2,020,696 or 12% in 2024 primarily from a result of the 32% fourth quarter increase in shipping coordination and label generation services due to the impacts of the Canada Post carrier strike. This event has had a significant impact on the entire Canadian transportation industry.

Client services revenues, which include brewery management software and shipping calculator services decreased $16,123 or 48% to $17,815 compared to $33,938 in 2023. The decrease was attributable to the cancellation of several clients using our brewery management software and the limited marketing of this segment of the business.

Shipping coordination and label generation services revenues increased $2,033,889 or 13% to $18,499,613 in 2024 compared to $16,465,724 in 2023. The increase is largely attributable to impacts of the Canada Post strike and the additional marketing for this segment of the business.

eCommerce services have launched its United States shipping portal which resulted in an increase of $2,930 or 4% to $68,097 in 2024 compared to $65,167 in 2023. The Company continues to increase the product offerings in this segment of the business.

Client services revenues, which include brewery management software and shipping calculator services decreased $13,951 or 78% to $3,863 compared to $17,815 in 2024. The decrease was attributable to the retirement of the brewery management software business.

Shipping coordination and label generation services revenues increased $2,178,219 or 12% to $20,677,832 in 2025 compared to $18,499,613 in 2024. The increase is largely attributable to impacts of the Canada Post strike and the additional marketing for this segment of the business.

The information contained in the Company's website should not be deemed to be a part of this Annual Report. The Company's principal executive offices are located at 225 Cedar Hill Street, Marlborough, Massachusetts 01752 with offices also located at 700 Dorval Drive, Oakville, Ontario, Canada. The Company's telephone number is (617) 861-6050.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Finance lease liabilities
lines.why: Leases that work like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

accounts.name: Cash and equivalents
accounts.note: The cash flow statement's cash can include restricted cash the balance sheet shows elsewhere: a small residual is that difference.

accounts.name: Property, plant and equipment
accounts.note: Depreciation and amortisation includes the amortisation of intangibles where the filing reports one line: the PP&E residual then carries the intangibles' share.

accounts.name: Goodwill and intangibles
accounts.note: Acquisitions add goodwill and intangibles at their allocated values, not at the cash paid; the residual is the difference and the amortisation.

accounts.name: Equity
accounts.note: Other comprehensive income (currency translation, unrealised gains) moves equity without passing through net income: it is in the residual.

s.t: This decision impacted many small businesses shipping goods to the United States from Canada impacting approximately 10% of our label generation customer revenues.
For customers headquartered in their respective countries, the Company derived approximately 99 % of its revenues from Canada and 1 % from the U.S. during the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024.

As of December 31, 2025 there were no customers that accounted for more than 10% and as of December 31, 2024 there was one customer that accounted for more than 10%, of the accounts receivable balance for the year.
You should not rely on the results for any period as an indication of future performance.
The successful operation of our business depends upon the supply of critical technology elements from other third parties, including our internet service provider and technology licensors.
Our operations depend on a number of third parties for internet/telecom access, delivery services, and software services.
We rely on an internet service provider to connect our websites to the internet.
Our internally developed software depends on the operating system, database and server software that was developed and produced by and licensed from third parties.
We have discovered from time-to-time errors and defects in the software from these third parties and, in part, rely on these third parties to correct these errors and defects in a timely manner.
Our Company's success still depends upon the continued services of its current management and other relationships.
Our Company's success will depend on our ability to attract and retain qualified personnel.

We believe that our future success will depend upon our ability to identify, attract, hire, train, motivate and retain other highly skilled managerial, accounting, technical consulting, marketing and customer service personnel.
Our success depends upon market awareness of our brand.
Because our success in part relies upon our technologies, if proper protection is not available or can be circumvented, our business may suffer.
We rely on a variety of technologies that we license from third parties.

We also rely on encryption and authentication technology licensed from a third party through an online user agreement to provide the security and authentication necessary to effect secure transmission of confidential information.
Our business depends on discretionary consumer and corporate spending.

We rely on encryption and authentication technology licensed from a third party through an online user agreement to provide the security and authentication necessary to effect secure transmission of confidential information.
